Hello! Let us solve this together. 

Look at the bottom numbers, three and six. 

How do we change three into six using times?
you multiply by two because 3 times 2 is 6 so you do the same to the top and get 4/6 Next one: 2/9 + 4/9?

Spot on! Four over six is right. 

Now for the next one: two over nine plus four over nine. 

Look at the bottom numbers. Are they the same?
yeah they are both 9 so you just add the top numbers to get 6/9 Next one: 1/4 + 1/8?

Yes! Six over nine is right. 

Now for one over four plus one over eight. 

Look at the bottom numbers. Are they the same?
um I think it is 2/12 but I am not really sure if that is right

That is a common guess, but it is not quite right. 

Do not add the bottom numbers together. 

We need to make the bottom numbers the same first. 

Can you change the four into an eight using times?
